verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a scheduling and calendar-assistant product, so it applies here. The evidence pack only describes a vendor-hosted service: the help docs, the hosted MCP endpoint on mcp.reclaim.ai, and the pricing plans. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
